findings.issue: Compact packet limit differed from indented on-disk size.
findings.resolution: Creation and writing use the same compact encoding including final newline.

evidence.test: near-limit canonical packet round-trips at the exact on-disk byte cap

findings.issue: The mandatory packet helper introduced an unconditional Git requirement.
findings.resolution: Non-Git scope is explicit and limited to declared in-root file snapshots; no Git tree or repository-wide coverage is invented. Native completion proof remains required.

tests: non-Git packets bind explicit file snapshots and disclose that the change inventory is limited
non-Git workflows retain required native review and invalidate edits inside the declared file scope

findings.issue: Interrupting the harness could leave its Copilot/tool child running and lose final evidence.
findings.resolution: Own process group, bounded signal forwarding/escalation and finally-recorded exit/integrity.

findings.issue: Harness metadata stayed at model-not-started after launch.
findings.resolution: Status changes to running after Popen and process-exited-awaiting-workflow-validation at exit; current invocation metadata was correlated to process.json and corrected.

evidence.limitation: First invocation metadata was corrected only after its recorded process exit; current harness updates status itself.

findings.issue: Independent consumer controller used an undomained raw session hash.
findings.resolution: Use the native domain-separated identity and reject mismatched sessions; exact actual first-run state verified read-only.

findings.issue: First live bundle exposed long audit/review/self-review references, native reanchor context drift and reviewer packet-line ambiguity.
findings.resolution: Final frozen package includes bounded authoritative references, native reanchor binding, exact packet-line examples, persona canonical packet parity and native search aliases.

evidence.limitation: Native success must be assessed from the separate fresh final run.

findings.issue: A later omitted dirty-before flag could discard pending audit context; invalid input or Git faults could also discard scope before a retry.
findings.resolution: Persist cumulative project/session/generation/log/claim scope before grading, validate explicit literal/hash predicates, preserve unchanged certified claims, and require a fresh clean scope at workflow termination.

evidence.kind: deterministic native-helper fixture; the first model run exposed the original failure

findings.issue: Original lifecycle checkboxes contradicted a completed managed status and could preclaim final report delivery.
findings.resolution: Known nonblocked lifecycle labels become neutral pointers; only the bound managed block records observed workflow flags. The assistant delivers its report after closure.

evidence.limitation: Live final progress is assessed separately.

findings.issue: Copied hook shell headers could generate repeated binding refusals.
findings.resolution: Recover only complete exact native selector headers or a naked marker; preserve ordinary commands/exports and reject partial protected selector overrides.

evidence.test: copied shell headers preserve ordinary exports and reject partial protected bindings

findings.issue: The controller inherited a stale PWD despite setting the actual project cwd, causing false path-preflight targets.
findings.resolution: Future harness launches set PWD to the resolved project and preflight from that directory. The completed native run remained unchanged and recovered using absolute paths.

findings.resolution: Only independently validated final native evidence records and the recomputed current tree may supersede that conservative ordering; stale/failing status output remains rejected.
